title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Saturday, 31 October 2026
description: A trillion-dollar global chip and AI stock sell-off hits Intel and Nvidia hardest, the federal government restricts spending on promotional merchandise, a weather front threatens storms for south-east Queensland, and the Gold Coast welcomes the first flight from Sydney's new Western Sydney International Airport. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
